::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Intel's largest design centre outside the United States. Bengaluru teams have contributed to multiple generations of Core processors and Xeon server chips.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Core and Xeon CPU microarchitecture, GPU design (Arc), AI accelerator IPs, platform validation, and firmware. India teams are involved in front-end design, verification, physical design, and post-silicon validation.
